purpose: Controlled source-only Off versus installed Engram engineering benchmark with clarified, preflighted task contracts

tasks.title: Skip task-guide work in the action hot path
acceptance: Absent switches preserve both guide families.
use_task_guides:false results in zero mock search requests and no task guide or deferred resolution, while retaining the app guide.
use_app_guides:false still searches for task guides and omits the app guide.
use_guide:false overrides both family switches.
Session action request conversion retains the switches.
Enforcing partner policy can disable task guides or all guides across the production request/context path, and cannot override a caller's opt-out.
environment: Preflight used Homebrew Rust 1.96.0; historical package declares a 1.91.1 minimum. Offline locked dependencies are prepared before agent timing. Behavioral grader uses in-process loopback search/cache mocks, no production database or model.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: Find the shared resolver, request conversion and policy merge without repeated route-by-route searches.
tasks.provenance: Narrow historical Git change; larger CHANGELOG 0.58.0 variant adds generate_guides.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

contract_changes_from_v1: Retain the enforcing policy context through resolution; no requirement that request normalization alone encode policy restrictions.

tasks.title: Make phone-task status polling lean by default
acceptance: Default result has the requested summary fields and no steps.
Default works when list_steps raises, using the count operation instead.
Explicit steps and since_step return the requested history; count remains total.
False boolean and string false disable include_steps only. A non-null since_step uses Python integer conversion, implies history, and returns -32602 when conversion fails.
Existing contract v1 JSON fields, scalar types and values remain compatible; additive optional fields and formatting changes are allowed. Preserve the actual device wire contract.
Consumers needing user-control steps explicitly request them.
environment: Python standard-library grader executes actual handler/service and consumer code with isolated external-service doubles. Preflight used Python 3.14.6. No development conftest, database, embeddings, network, or subprocesses; the candidate may add isolated tests.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: Find contract versioning obligations, the expensive Redis call and consumers beyond the handler.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

reference_limitations: The v2 prompt explicitly retains historical Python integer conversion for cursors, including booleans and fractional numbers.
New v2 fixtures are checked if supplied; a v2 directory is not required.
Synthetic API response-byte measurements are product metrics, not coding-agent token savings.
contract_changes_from_v1: Semantic JSON compatibility replaces byte identity for historical contract fixtures.
Cursor coercion and include_steps false parsing are explicit.

tasks.title: Keep developer environment files out of contract tests
acceptance: Test environment does not reload scrubbed values from a synthetic .env.
Non-test local startup still loads .env.
A deliberately poisoned shared test lock does not cascade into unrelated lock panics.
The original failure remains visible.
environment: Preflight used Homebrew Rust 1.96.0 with offline locked dependencies. Private tests use harmless synthetic .env values and fresh subprocesses; no database, Redis, or model is started.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: Locate the settings constructor and shared harness together. A small control can show no benefit or negative overhead.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

tasks.title: Bound onboarding checks without redirect loops
acceptance: 500, unreachable, and malformed JSON/non-JSON backend responses do not admit users to gated pages.
Welcome stays usable on the same failures without redirect loops.
Completed users pass the gate and leave welcome for a safe destination.

A five-second deadline covers response headers and body consumption. Header/request timeouts return failure with status 503 or 504; interrupted body failures may return 502, 503 or 504. The gate stays closed and welcome remains usable.
Unsafe return URLs remain blocked, including existing invalid-route handling for pathnames containing ://; safe invite/CLI destinations survive.
environment: Node v26.5.1, Vitest 4.1.5, and MSW 2.13.5 in a private cloned dependency tree; this is not a lockfile-exact historical installation. Identical prepared dependencies are used across arms. No live Clerk or backend; deadline grading uses real timers and fetch aborts.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: Reuse server-action/fetch conventions and understand opposite gate and welcome-page redirects.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

reference_limitations: Malformed response means invalid JSON syntax or a non-JSON body; schema-invalid but syntactically valid profiles remain outside this task.
Deadline grading allows 500 ms scheduling tolerance; independent checks cover profile, gate and welcome outcomes, including stalled bodies.
Prepared dependency lock differs from historical source lock; record both, use identical dependencies across arms, and recalibrate controls before collection.
contract_changes_from_v1: Header/request timeout failures may use 503 or 504; interrupted body failures may also use 502.
The deadline includes response-body consumption; profile, gate and welcome outcomes are graded independently.

runtime.repetitions_interpretation: Three repetitions are diagnostic, not statistically decisive.

coding_environment.git_configuration: Global/system config and global exclude rules disabled.
coding_environment.cargo_home: Private per-arm registry-only copy; no inherited credentials or Git checkout cache.
coding_environment.prepared_dependencies: Identical frozen starting dependencies across arms.
coding_environment.pnpm_note: Prevents pnpm 11 automatic package-manager download or dependency reinstall during coding.

provider_prompt_cache.limitation: Provider prompt-cache state is not reset or controlled between trials. Report cache-creation and cache-read tokens separately. CLI cost is an estimate, not subscription cash billing.

measurement_scope: New 24-run diagnostic comparison; not a retrospective rescore or a causal comparison to v1 outcomes.
attempt_retention: Retain every completed attempt and all interrupted infrastructure evidence. Stop for inspection after an unscorable/provider-error result; resume at the next planned ID without replacing the attempt.
